name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: Cooking serves as the core cornerstone of survival in the wilds, providing not only sustenance but the essential skill to spark a campfire around which an entire campsite is built.
Adventurers traveling through Mulgore begin their frontier survival training in Bloodhoof Village under the guidance of local tauren craftsmen and cooks.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that teaches adventurers how cooking and fire-making form the literal foundation of surviving in the wild. By learning cooking, an adventurer gains the ability to create campfires and establish campsites in the field.
Pyall Silentstride is a cooking trainer situated in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He instructs novice adventurers in the culinary arts and teaches them how to build basic campfires.
In the wilderness, cooking is about more than preparing meals; learning to cook teaches an adventurer how to kindle a campfire, which acts as the physical and practical anchor for any campsite.
faq.q: Why is cooking necessary to learn camping?

faq.answer: As you advance and raise your cooking skill, you develop the knowledge required to build larger, sturdier fires, allowing for more substantial campsite setups in the wilderness.
faq.q: Can you make bigger campfires as your skill improves?

faq.answer: While a campfire provides the central anchor of a campsite, additional furnishings and accessories can be learned from other tradeskill trainers across the world if you are trained in their crafts.
faq.q: How do you furnish a campsite?

faq.answer: Once you understand how to kindle a campfire through basic cooking training, you are able to establish a humble camp out in the open wilderness wherever your travels take you.
faq.q: Where can you set up a camp?

sections.body: Every long journey through the untamed wilds demands basic wilderness survival, and every true camp begins with fire. For wanderers stepping across Kalimdor, the quest Camping 101: Cooking introduces the essential relationship between culinary training and frontier survival. Cooking is not merely about preparing nourishing meals from hunted game; it provides the fundamental knowledge needed to build a working campfire out in the elements. Without a fire, an adventurer has no camp to return to when night falls.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Wild

sections.body: In the rolling plains of Mulgore, adventurers are directed to Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village to learn the basics of cooking. With this foundational training, an adventurer gains the ability to strike a campfire anywhere in the wilderness and pitch a basic camp. While initial camps are simple and allow few furnishings, advancing one's cooking proficiency unlocks the secrets of kindling larger fires. In turn, craftsmen versed in other trades can craft furnishings to flesh out their frontier outposts.
sections.title: Building the Camp

summary: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that instructs adventurers on how basic culinary knowledge forms the foundation of establishing a campsite in the wilderness. By seeking out Pyall Silentstride in Bloodhoof Village, travelers learn to build a campfire to anchor their camp and prepare for life on the frontier.
